identity.title: Is Divine Simplicity True? Joe Schmid (@Majesty of Reason) Vs. Fr. Gregory Pine Debate
identity.dateBasis: YouTube watch metadata gives 2021-05-17; publisher description explicitly identifies this as a re-upload of the April debate. Exact April day is not asserted.

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

content.coverageNote: Captions cover both openings, the complete discussion, audience questions, both closings, and outro music; the final 6.73 seconds are beyond the last music caption. All gaps above two seconds occur in the post-debate outro.

participants.basis: Complete transcript reviewed by controller. Pine and Schmid alone advance opposing motion arguments. Fradd introduces, times, redirects, reads questions, and requests clarification of existing speaker claims; his remark that Schmid’s existing self-change response sounded reasonable introduces no premise or independent argument. No third advocate or unique host argument is present.

unscoredMaterial: Introductions, channel promotion, sponsor interlude, favorite-saint social conversation, moderator question wording, procedural turns, and outro are not participant argument evidence.
format.qAndABoundary: Only substantive answers adopted by the two debaters may be selected; question-reading and audience assertions are not credited as independent arguments.
